'''Cinnabar''' was a [[red]] mineral found in the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] crust of [[Fiddanl]]. Along with lemony-orange [[sulfite]]s, purple [[Manganese/Legends|manganese]], and green rock made up the crust of [[Fiddanl]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="GG2" />
